admission.justification: The application supplies typed tool-scoped values to the model fitter, and the completion and fitting tests distinguish whole result values, delivered field order and priority of omission notices.

applicability: Short-form delivery by the shared answer guard for a declared tool and wire Boolean outcome.
conditions: The guard reads declared fields from the validated whole result.
A declared value is eligible when present with its expected type.
The guard reserves the location or no-file outcome and the final hint before fitting declared values.
exclusions: Uncut answers and separately owned tool-specific answer shaping.
The exact recorded locator and final hint may exceed the target when their required envelope alone cannot fit.
statement: The shared overflow guard puts fitting declared outcomes and next actions before the exact recorded locator when available. It keeps any reported log error. Without a recorded locator it sets resultKept to false and ends with a no-file hint. For each eligible field it reserves a fitting whole value or named omission before considering the next field.
